generation.explanation: A positive result is not 90% likely to mean disease, because the disease is rare. Out of 1,000 people, about 9 sick people test positive, but about 99 healthy people also test positive—so the chance is 9/(9+99) ≈ 8.3%. Use the slider to see how changing the underlying prevalence changes this result.
